rules.title: Direct Code-Level Consumption Edge
rules.rationale: An asset that directly USES a target is affected if the target changes signature, algorithm, or protocol.

rules.title: Package or Library Dependency Edge
rules.rationale: Downstream package or component depends on upstream cryptographic provider.

rules.title: Service Provisioning or Binding Edge
rules.rationale: Application component serves or exposes a network service using this cryptographic configuration.

rules.title: Data Protection Boundary Edge
rules.rationale: Cryptographic mechanism protects confidentiality or integrity of persistent data assets.

rules.title: Direct Single-Hop Dependent Path
rules.rationale: Immediate consumer directly invokes or links to target crypto asset.

rules.title: Transitive Multi-Hop Dependent Path
rules.rationale: Indirect consumer depends on intermediate library, module, or service which consumes target.

rules.title: Multiple Independent Impact Paths
rules.rationale: Multiple independent paths link the consumer to the cryptographic target across different architectural facets.

rules.title: No Dependents Observed in Graph Scope
rules.rationale: No callers, dependencies, or consuming services observed within current scan graph boundary.
rules.limitations: Absence of observed dependents does not imply zero real-world risk or unused dead code.

rules.title: Local Module / Component Impact
rules.rationale: Impact is strictly confined to internal functions or files within the same component.

rules.title: Direct Immediate Dependent Impact
rules.rationale: All impacted assets are immediate first-hop consumers.

rules.title: Transitive Single-Service Impact
rules.rationale: Impact propagates across multiple hops but remains inside a single application/service boundary.

rules.title: Multi-Service Architectural Blast Radius
rules.rationale: Cryptographic modification affects two or more distinct services across service boundaries.

rules.title: Cross-Deployment Impact
rules.rationale: Impact spans across multiple independent deployment targets, clusters, or containers.

rules.title: Widespread Enterprise Blast Radius
rules.rationale: Widespread footprint across the enterprise graph requiring coordinated migration orchestration.

rules.title: Production Environment Asset
rules.rationale: Asset is actively deployed in a verified production environment.

rules.title: Direct Protection of Regulated Data Asset
rules.rationale: Cryptographic algorithm or key directly protects sensitive, regulated, or high-retention data.

rules.title: Externally Exposed Ingress Endpoint
rules.rationale: Cryptographic protocol secures publicly accessible ingress or perimeter boundary.

rules.title: Internal Microservice Communication
rules.rationale: Impact is confined to internal mesh or backend processing microservices.

rules.title: Development or Ephemeral Asset
rules.condition: env == 'dev' or env == 'test' or ephemeral == true
rules.rationale: Asset resides in development, staging, or transient testing environment.

rules.title: Unknown Criticality from Missing Evidence
rules.rationale: Insufficient evidence exists to categorize architectural criticality without speculation.
